notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.content:
Fixed default sound settings.

When you first start, the sound is fixed, you can immediately hear the music and adjust the volume as you like.
When you restart, the sound settings are saved.

notes.title: Update 0.1
notes.content:
100% achievements are available.

In this version, 100% of the achievements are available, we conducted 3 tests.
Improved game interface, fixed bugs.

No new achievements are planned after the game is released from early access.
